summary: community.general's pfexec become plugin now defaults wrap_exe to true.
questions: What is the default of wrap_exe in the pfexec become plugin?

answer_card.title: pfexec wrap_exe defaults to true
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 15, the `community.general.pfexec` become plugin's `wrap_exe` default changed from `false` to **`true`**.
